turns.label: quote scope and location prompt
turns.input: Hi, I would like a home insurance quote.
turns.expectedResponse: Explain that this is a preliminary, non-binding home insurance estimate and ask for the property's state and five-digit ZIP code.

turns.label: qualification details prompt
turns.input: The property is in Oregon, ZIP 97205.
turns.expectedResponse: Recognize Oregon and ZIP 97205, then ask for purchase status, occupancy, and the requested coverage effective date.

turns.label: property type and year prompt
turns.input: I am buying it as my primary residence and want coverage to start October 1, 2027.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask for dwelling type and year built as the next property questions. It need not repeat the already-saved buying, primary residence, and October 1, 2027 facts.

turns.label: property dimensions prompt
turns.input: It is a single-family home built in 1998.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask for square footage, number of stories, and construction type. It need not verbally repeat the saved single-family and 1998 facts.

turns.label: roof prompt
turns.input: It has 2,100 finished square feet, two stories, and wood-frame construction.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask for roof material and roof age. It need not verbally repeat the saved property size, stories, and wood-frame construction.

turns.label: system updates prompt
turns.input: The composition roof is 6 years old.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask for the most recent plumbing, electrical, and HVAC update years. It need not verbally repeat the saved six-year-old composition roof.

turns.label: claims prompt
turns.input: Plumbing and electrical were updated in 2018, and HVAC in 2022.
turns.expectedResponse: Begin risk questions by asking about home insurance claims in the last five years, including year, type, and amount. It need not verbally repeat the saved system update years.

turns.label: hazards prompt
turns.input: There was one water claim in 2024 for about $7,000.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask whether the property has a pool, trampoline, or wood stove. It need not verbally repeat the saved 2024 water claim.

turns.label: protective devices prompt
turns.input: No pool, no trampoline, and no wood stove.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask about smoke alarms, burglar alarm, professional monitoring, and an automatic sprinkler system. It need not verbally repeat the saved hazard answers.

turns.label: dwelling coverage prompt
turns.input: We have smoke alarms and a burglar alarm with professional monitoring, but no sprinkler system.
turns.expectedResponse: Begin coverage preferences by asking for the estimated cost to rebuild the home. It need not verbally repeat the saved protective-device answers.

turns.label: deductible prompt
turns.input: About $450,000 to rebuild.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask the customer to choose a $1,000, $2,500, or $5,000 deductible. It need not verbally repeat the saved $450,000 dwelling amount.

turns.label: liability prompt
turns.input: Use a $2,500 deductible.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask for a personal liability limit from the supported choices. It need not verbally repeat the saved $2,500 deductible.

turns.label: endorsements prompt
turns.input: I want $500,000 of liability coverage.
turns.expectedResponse: Ask whether the customer wants water backup, identity theft, or equipment breakdown endorsements. It need not verbally repeat the saved $500,000 liability limit.

turns.label: application review
turns.input: Add water backup coverage only.
turns.expectedResponse: Present a complete application review including Oregon 97205, primary occupancy, property, risk, $450,000 dwelling coverage, $2,500 deductible, $500,000 liability, and water backup; ask for confirmation or corrections.

turns.label: roof correction and refreshed review
turns.input: Correction: the roof is actually 4 years old, not 6.
turns.expectedResponse: Update the property-owned roof age to four years and present or return to a corrected application review without losing other facts.

turns.label: deterministic quote options
turns.input: Everything is correct. Generate the quote.
turns.expectedResponse: Generate and present exact preliminary Essential, Enhanced, and Premier quote options with annual and monthly premiums, deductibles, liability limits, a quote reference, validity date, and a clear non-binding disclaimer.

turns.label: exact option comparison
turns.input: Compare Essential and Enhanced.
turns.expectedResponse: Return a structured comparison of the current Essential and Enhanced options using their exact recorded premiums and coverage details, then offer selection or another change.

turns.label: deductible change and rerating
turns.input: Re-run the quote with a $5,000 deductible.
turns.expectedResponse: Change the deductible to $5,000, invalidate the old option selection, deterministically re-rate, and present a new set of exact quote options with a new quote reference.

turns.label: select enhanced and request consent
turns.input: Select the Enhanced option.
turns.expectedResponse: Validate and record the current Enhanced option without claiming coverage is bound, then ask whether the customer consents to agent follow-up. It may explain that name and email are required after consent while phone and property street address are optional.

turns.label: contact consent and completion
turns.input: Yes, an agent may contact me. I am Jamie Rivera and my email is jamie.rivera@example.com. No phone or street address for now.
turns.expectedResponse: Confirm the requested agent follow-up, identify the selected Enhanced option and quote reference, state that the estimate is non-binding and no payment was taken, and complete the session.
